live_web_research.title: Anytime Contracts for AI Services - arXiv.org
live_web_research.snippet: Due to their generality, AI systems are increasingly viewed as tools, used for indefinite durations within organizational processes. Accordingly, payment for such services typically takes the form of auto-renewing contracts or pay-as-you-go APIs, which are arrangements without a predetermined end.

article.body:
AI service payments often have no fixed end

AI services are typically paid for through auto-renewing contracts or pay-as-you-go APIs, arrangements without a predetermined end, according to “Anytime Contracts for AI Services.” The available account identifies no buyer, provider or contract value, so it establishes no specific transaction or changed customer relationship.
